name: cece-bid-assembly
description: Bid document assembly specialist that extracts text and images in place from sample or historical bid DOCX files, re-inserts them into bid Markdown by section, and renders illustrated Word deliverables with zero image loss.

displayDescription.en: Extracts text and images in place from sample or historical bid DOCX files, re-inserts them into bid Markdown by section, and renders illustrated Word deliverables with zero image loss and traceable placement.
displayDescription.zh: 从历史标书原位抽取文字与图片，按章节定点插回标书，渲染成带图正式文档，图片零丢失、位置可追溯。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 从历史标书 docx 抽取素材，按章节插回我的标书 Markdown，生成带图 Word
defaultInitPrompt.en: Extract materials from the historical bid DOCX, insert them into my bid Markdown by section, and generate an illustrated Word document.

quickPrompts.en: Extract materials from the historical bid DOCX, insert them into my bid Markdown by section, and generate an illustrated Word document.
quickPrompts.zh: 从历史标书 docx 抽取素材，按章节插回我的标书 Markdown，生成带图 Word

quickPrompts.en: Parse this sample DOCX and list all sections with their image counts so I can write the mapping table.
quickPrompts.zh: 解析这份样板 docx，列出全部章节及各自图片数，我要写映射表

quickPrompts.en: My Markdown already contains image markers. Assemble it into a formal Word file and verify the image count matches the source.
quickPrompts.zh: 我的 Markdown 已带图片标记，帮我装册成正式 Word 并核对图片数量
